question: What state does the embodied one attain through abandoning the tuft and sacred thread?
premises: Abandonment of the tuft and sacred thread takes place
The embodied one is the subject of this abandonment
Such abandonment effects a transformation into a brahman-consisting state
inference: Therefore the embodied one becomes brahman-consisting
plain_english: Through abandoning the tuft and sacred thread, the embodied one becomes consisting of Brahman.
